snippet.title: Widget Idle | Announcement Trailer | Your Desktop Companion
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4634570/Widget_Idle/

An idle game that grows as it lives on your desktop. Fill the grid, collect the stamps, pet the nautilus, and uncover the forgotten secrets of productivity.
